references.text: The description of the holy incense to be used in the tabernacle, which is what the golden bowl in Numbers 7:14 was filled with.
Refers to basins and bowls of pure gold to be used in the sanctuary, corresponding to the golden bowl mentioned here.
Describes the making of vessels of pure gold for the sanctuary, including bowls.
Describes the use of incense in the sanctuary, showing the purpose of the incense in the golden bowl.
Identical gift from Nahshon, illustrating the pattern of a golden bowl filled with incense from each tribal leader.
Summary of all twelve golden bowls filled with incense that were given by the tribal leaders.
Golden bowls full of incense in heaven, representing the prayers of the saints, linking incense to worship.
An angel with a golden censer offering incense together with the prayers of the saints, showing the symbolic meaning of the incense.
